english_translation: One should not perform theft, One should not speak falsely, One should touch unstable and firm beings with kindness, One should know any disturbance of mind and dispel it as “a flank of the Dark One.”

class_example: anattani, bhikkhave, attāti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
english_translation: "In regard to what is not (a) self, "(This is) self". (is) the distortion of perception, the distortion of thought, the distortion of view.

class_example: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo yam'enaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti, yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ, taṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti.
english_translation: Here, monks, a king's bull elephant to whichever task the elephant trainer has him perform, whether [it] has been previously done or not previously done, having focused and paid attention on that (task), having concentrated completely with the mind, he listens with applied ear.

english_translation: Teachings of such quality are well-learned by him, remembered, verbally practised, mentally reflected upon, and thoroughly understood by view.

class_example: gopālako sāyanhasamaye sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati: "ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñ'ca amukasmiñ'ca padese cariṃsu"
english_translation: In the evening, a young cowherd, having handed over the cattle to the owners, reflects thus: “Today, indeed, the cattle grazed in this place and in that place…”

class_example: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rājāno balavanto honti, corā tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti. tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.
english_translation: At whichever time kings are strong, robbers are weak. At that time it is easy for the king to re-enter or to go out and to visit the outlying districts.
